artifacts.evidence: Measured from pinned public point collections. JSON p fields are xyz; current fitter reverses p to internal zyx.
Measured from pinned current public umbilicus control points; frame assignment is still subject to origin/registration verification.
Aggregate of nine pinned official S3 meta.json bboxes used by the constraint-gauge mesh arm.
Current public packed-store metadata; no channel bricks downloaded.

limitations: TIFXYZ bboxes are metadata; this run does not reread the coordinate TIFFs, although the benchmark and tifxyz-repair report these finished meshes clean.
The packed grad_mag shape describes allocated array support, not which bricks or voxels contain nonzero winding density.
The group-4 38.4um frame is derived from 9.6um working voxels times lasagna_scale=4 and still requires parity against the original E1 annotated run.
All origins and axis directions are provisionally aligned at zero; volume registration must be confirmed before declaring ray coverage.
Aggregate bounding-box intersection does not imply every pair or seven-ray offset lies within nonzero field support.
